checklist.item: Dependency direction: the dependencies between the repositories, against the intended direction in docs/architecture.md of pulse-meta; flag every cycle and every dependency in the wrong direction.
checklist.evidence: python3 -I deps.py .repos (exit 0) builds edges from package.json, workflow uses: and checkouts, Compose image/build, api bench, website docs.config.json and PULSE_API_URL reads. Cycles over library pins: 0; with runtime: 0; with CI checkouts: 1 (console -> deploy -> console); over all kinds: 4 (api -> notify|probe|status -> api through the documented bench, and console -> deploy -> console).
